evidence_scope: Local final source snapshot; published and merged commits receive independent GitHub CI. Source hashes identify the tested production, test, packaging and documentation files.

pretrained_models.inference_network: Linux network namespace without outbound network access
pretrained_models.model_provisioning: Separate Hugging Face download-only process; no inference runtime imported

coverage.scope: Complete production Python package in ordinary unit/integration/PostgreSQL parent processes; native-model subprocesses, live HTTP, wheel, browser and container checks do not contribute.

limitations: Small sequential workload, not concurrency/production capacity or retrieval quality.
First-use timing includes checkpoint loading and any missing downloads.
Warm timings include adapter preflight; model RAM and process RSS are not measured.

architecture_repairs.shared_connection_lifecycle: SQLite setup/commit/rollback/close shared by Store and AssetStore; PostgreSQL lifecycle delegated unchanged.

sqlite_scoping.claim: Reduced Python materialization; no constant-time or ANN claim.

frozen_contracts.dependency_changes: pyproject.toml and uv.lock add optional embedding/tokenizer dependencies; previous frozen research/admission requirements are unchanged.
frozen_contracts.qwen_admission_quality: Historical report remains 7 of 11 quality gates passed, not promoted. No new Qwen/Inkling performance result is claimed.

limitations: Five trained encoder presets were actually executed. Offline hash vectors and HTTP fixture vectors are not trained-model performance evidence.

Ten sequential warm samples per role on a shared CPU establish a smoke measurement, not retrieval quality, concurrent capacity, memory usage or production latency. With this estimator and sample size, p95 equals the maximum.
Sentence Transformers checkpoints use immutable revisions. FastEmbed preparation resolves main and records the actual resolved revisions and file hashes; those download inputs are not immutable pins.
Weights were provisioned before the recorded offline inference. First-use timings measure runtime loading and encoding with those cached artifacts, not download duration.

An initial network-enabled native test was blocked by automatic approval review for attempted Microsoft telemetry. It is excluded from passing evidence; successful inference used an OS network namespace with all outbound networking unavailable.
The remaining 25 explicit resource/E2E cases retain their separate CI gates; they are not selected skips. The full frozen Qwen admission benchmark remains an unchanged manual job.
Upstream Starlette/httpx deprecation warnings remain; they do not change the zero-skip gate.
